'''July 2001 Melbourne tournament (29 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 29 July 2001. [[Adam Amy]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2732">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-melbourne-australia-27-7-2k1d2732/ melbourne-australia-27-7-2k1], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 30 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-melbourne-australia-27-7-2k1d2732/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Adam Amy]]
